title: ‘Today or tomorrow, Siang Dam will be built,’ says BJP MP amid protests in Arunachal Pradesh

ai.summary: Arunachal Pradesh BJP MP Tapir Gao claimed the Siang Upper Multipurpose Project (SUMP) dam would be built 'today or tomorrow' despite protests, stating it was declared a national project in 2008 by the Manmohan Singh government. The state government maintained no final decision has been taken to construct the dam, with the current phase limited to a pre-feasibility report.
